source.zh: UV 布局取自 Meta MHR v1.0.1 的 LOD0 网格（Apache-2.0），经 skin-source.u32 搬到发布的皮肤上；移植片和开口构造追加的顶点按最近的 MHR 面投影取 UV。由 tools/look/uv.ts 生成。
source.en: The UV layout is MHR v1.0.1's LOD0 mesh (Meta, Apache-2.0), carried over to the shipped skin through skin-source.u32; vertices appended by grafts and the construction of the openings take the UV of the nearest MHR face. Built by tools/look/uv.ts.
